blocks.text: Require diagnostics.profiler@^1.0.0 and use PROFILERS to create independent viewer-local profilers. Call begin with the wall-frame interval, lap after timed sections and end once per rendered frame. Fixed ring buffers retain 600 frames and 1000 events. Percentile/group/history calculations run on request; diagnostic timing never changes deterministic simulation. Precise mode invokes the supplied optional renderer flush. Removing the package leaves gameplay and renderer lifetime independent.

Use summary/history/log for a window, text log or export; drawGraph optionally renders a canvas graph. Dispose an instance or its provider to stop collection and release retained events. Browsers, offline viewers and headless diagnostic consumers can compose the same service; initialization requires no DOM, ship, world or renderer.

Configuration: precise is 0 (normal) or 1 (flush deferred raster work at each lap). longWorkMs sets the diagnostic slow-work threshold, default 11 ms. These viewer-only values never affect simulation.
